title: How big is each object?
prompt: Place each object by its length, smallest to largest.

items.label: A grain of rice
items.fact: A single grain is about 6 mm long — engravers famously write on them.

items.label: A smartphone
items.fact: A typical phone is about 15 cm tall.

items.label: A basketball
items.fact: A regulation ball is about 24 cm across.

items.label: An adult human
items.fact: The global average adult height is roughly 1.7 m.

items.label: A school bus
items.fact: A full-size school bus runs about 11 m end to end.

items.label: A blue whale
items.fact: The longest animal ever — about the length of three school buses.
